diagnosis.cause: ANE compiler F_PREALLOCATE failed with No space left on device while growing a temporary file from 4682940416 to 4955570176 bytes. CoreAI flattened it to a generic compilation error.
diagnosis.recoverySequence: Encoder repair succeeded, then stale base cache failed; base repair compilation ran out of disk.
diagnosis.fix: Measure immediate free working capacity before cold specialization/cache repair; classify compilation failures; preserve successful repairs in a bounded cascade; allow explicit retries with a 60-second cooldown; record sanitized child failures.
diagnosis.preservation: Downloaded model and saved voice are excluded from recovery deletions. Existing working specialization entries remain intact.

fallbackAssessment.scope: Read-only assessment of fallback options for native Mac VoxCPM2 cloned voice while Neural Engine preparation recovers. No GPU/CPU backend or additional model download was implemented.

currentRuntime.framework: Public Core AI API on macOS 27; isolated RockClonedVoiceWorker process.
currentRuntime.artifact: Architecture-specific ANE-compiled .aimodelc base, residual, encoder, and diffusion stages; checkpoint contains CPU ancillary and AudioVAE weights.
constraints: Apple documents matching runtime compute options to the compute units used for AOT compilation. Changing the preference is not a dependable GPU/CPU recovery path for these ANE assets.
Core AI compute preference fallback handles incompatible operations during specialization; it does not promise failover from a broken ANE cache.
A dependable alternate backend needs portable .aimodel assets, separately exported GPU/CPU assets, or an independent runtime and checkpoint.

savedVoice.recommendation: Keep the saved voice file unchanged. Implement and validate an adapter for the same VoxCPM2 checkpoint revision rather than asking the user to record again.
savedVoice.limitation: Latent reuse is feasible in principle, not validated with an alternate backend; upstream high-level MLX interfaces normally accept reference audio.

recommendation: Fix the present preparation and retry mechanism first.
Prototype an independent GPU backend before enabling automatic fallback; CPU-only VoxCPM2 is unmeasured and should not be promised as a usable live-reply path.
Use per-backend worker isolation, cache identities, readiness receipts, and bounded failures.
Switch engines only between utterances; never replay expired or canceled meeting replies.
Throttle or pause ANE rebuilding while GPU synthesis is active to avoid simultaneous memory and CPU pressure.
Expose temporary GPU use in status without changing the selected saved voice; return to ANE only after a successful smoke test.
Offer the built-in macOS voice explicitly when no alternate assets are installed; avoid silently changing speaker identity or downloading gigabytes during a disk-space incident.
